name: List
gloss: the element that holds the items

name: Group
gloss: a heading that divides the items, with its own count or sentence

name: Detail
gloss: the card that shows one item in full

name: Meta
gloss: an item's or a group's code, count, amount, date, kind or status

name: Summary
gloss: a line or two describing the item

name: Body
gloss: the item's own content shown inside it: a diff, a script, a small chart, a panel it expands in place

name: Links
gloss: links from the item or group to other things: tags that filter the list, doors to other views, related documents

name: Actions
gloss: controls that act on the item or group
